One isolated asset only, facing straight toward the TOP of the image. Center its body/rotation pivot exactly at the canvas center. Square 1024x1024 composition with generous transparent margins. Actual transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no watermark, no insignia. Team color convention: flat saturated MAGENTA paint panels (RGB about 255,0,255) in small clearly defined opaque areas; ONLY the team-color panels may use magenta, with neutral gray/olive materials everywhere else. Preserve that separation for shader recoloring. No colored rim lighting. Subject: one infantry soldier holding an assault rifle with both hands, rifle pointed toward the top; overhead helmet, shoulders and backpack visible, compact stable standing pose. Small magenta team paint on helmet crown and shoulder armor, olive fatigues, steel rifle. No muzzle flash, no second pose, no ground tile.
